findings.evidence: Its statement mentions only `Set.indicator`, `integral` and `MeasurableSet`; the proof is `rw [← integral_indicator hS]` plus a case split, independent of the PDE subject (Mathlib `integral_indicator`, Bochner/Set.lean:181).
findings.fix: Generalize it to an arbitrary measurable space and normed codomain, move it to `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Integral/` (or upstream it as a Mathlib candidate), and make it public.
findings.issue: `integral_indicator_eq_setIntegral` (`∫ h x (S.indicator g x) = ∫_S h x (g x)` when `h x 0 = 0`) is general Bochner-integral infrastructure, but it is `private` and needlessly restricted to `EuclideanSpace ℝ ι`.

findings.evidence: Its proof is `rw [← lintegral_indicator hS]` plus `ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos` (Mathlib `lintegral_indicator`, Lebesgue/Basic.lean:509); nothing in it is specific to the PDE argument.
findings.fix: Generalize it and move it next to the previous lemma as a public lemma, then use it in that `calc` step instead of the inline proof.
findings.issue: `lintegral_enorm_indicator_rpow` (`∫⁻ (‖S.indicator g x‖ₑ / c) ^ p = ∫⁻_S (‖g x‖ₑ / c) ^ p` for `p > 0`) is the same kind of general infrastructure, also `private` and specialized to `EuclideanSpace`. The `calc` step rewriting `∫⁻ x in Omega, ‖W1p.gradient u x‖ₑ ^ p` to `∫⁻ x in Omega, f x ^ p` in `exists_lintegral_enorm_gradient_rpow_le_divergence` proves the identity again inline.

summary: The new public declarations and the changed Caccioppoli signature are placed and scoped correctly, with no compatibility layer. Two general measure-theory identities are hidden as `private` helpers in the PDE file, specialized to `EuclideanSpace`, and should be generalized, moved to an integration file and made public.
